dataset.Name: Elliptic-curve arithmetic inputs
dataset.Source_or_Definition: JohnCremona/ecdata pinned git submodule; canonical controlled source file allcurves/allcurves.00000-09999 at commit 25cec5ecfec8b9f016eb1631ac633194c2bed39f.
dataset.Notes: Exact upstream git source and bytes are locked in preregistrations/EXP-MAP-A01/dataset_manifest.json. Full source has 64,687 rows; EXP-MAP-A01 separately selects curve number 1 per isogeny class (38,042 rows). data/raw/ci_subset.csv is a CI fixture only, not a controlled input.
dataset.Current_Audit_Assessment: Exact ecdata gitlink, source revision, license, source-file identity, SHA-256, schema, and 38,042 representative selection are locked for EXP-MAP-A01 preregistration. Historical quarantined projection packages remain diagnostic-only and are not inputs. Controlled execution remains disabled until separate activation review.

provenance.Acquisition_Method: Repository git submodule data/ecdata pinned to the exact upstream commit; canonical file allcurves/allcurves.00000-09999
provenance.Original_Format: ecdata allcurves whitespace-delimited text: conductor isogeny curve_number [a1,a2,a3,a4,a6] rank torsion_order
provenance.Transformation_History: None for canonical source bytes. EXP-MAP-A01 performs an in-memory preregistered selection of curve_number=1 per isogeny class and exact discriminant derivation; no rewritten source artifact is substituted.
provenance.Selection_Criteria: Canonical source includes all 64,687 rows in allcurves.00000-09999 (conductors 11-9999). EXP-MAP-A01 analysis cohort retains exactly curve number 1 per isogeny class, yielding 38,042 representatives.
provenance.Missingness_Policy: No imputation or fallback. Malformed/blank source lines, duplicate curve labels, duplicate number-1 class representatives, unexpected row counts, or singular derived curves fail closed.
provenance.License_or_Usage: Artistic License 2.0 per upstream ecdata README/LICENSE.
provenance.Notes: Controlled provenance verified directly against the pinned JohnCremona/ecdata git submodule. The prior historical derived cremona_3selmer_full_pari.csv is not the canonical input for EXP-MAP-A01. Acquisition_Date records the controlled provenance capture/reverification date, not the upstream publication date.

parameter.Definition: EXP-MAP-A01-prereg-v1: one number-1 representative per ecdata isogeny class; Delta is the exact Weierstrass discriminant from [a1,a2,a3,a4,a6]; N is ecdata conductor; r is ecdata algebraic rank; longitude=360*ln(|Delta|)/ln(1e30); latitude=180*ln(N)/ln(1e9); elevation=200*r; natural logarithms; no clipping, fitting, sample-derived normalization, jitter or regulator term; endpoint uses k=10 Euclidean nearest neighbors in longitude/latitude only and T=-mean absolute elevation difference on unique undirected edges with Cremona-label tie breaking.

null.Definition: EXP-MAP-A01-prereg-v1 rank-permutation fixed-base null: hold curve identities, Delta, conductor, longitude/latitude point cloud, k=10 neighbor graph and empirical rank/elevation multiset fixed; permute ranks across curve identities using splitmix64-fisher-yates-v1 with seed=1729 for exactly B=999 sequential realizations; no discarded/regenerated nulls; p=(1+count(T_null>=T_obs))/(B+1); one-sided alpha=0.01; single endpoint, no multiplicity adjustment.

experiment_selection.policy: retain exactly curve number 1 from each isogeny class
experiment_selection.reason: Rank is isogeny invariant; one representative prevents within-class duplication from mechanically inflating local rank coherence.

status.statement: This preregistration verifies exact source bytes and source revision but does not open the controlled-execution gate.
